from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
import numpy as np

def solve_cfd_hpc_pipeline():
    # Define the quadratic program
    qp = QuadraticProgram()

    # Add binary variables
    for i in range(1, 10):
        qp.binary_var(name=f"x{i}")

    # Add budget constraint
    budget_expr = 2 * qp.variables[0] + qp.variables[1] + 3 * qp.variables[2] + qp.variables[3] + 2 * qp.variables[4] + qp.variables[5] + 3 * qp.variables[6] + 2 * qp.variables[7] + qp.variables[8]
    qp.linear_constraint(budget_expr, '<=', 12, name='budget')

    # Add precedence constraints
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.variables[2] - qp.variables[0], '<=', 0, name='precedence_1')
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.variables[4] - qp.variables[1], '<=', 0, name='precedence_2')
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.variables[6] - qp.variables[3], '<=', 0, name='precedence_3')
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.variables[7] - qp.variables[4], '<=', 0, name='precedence_4')

    # Add objective function
    objective_expr = 5 * qp.variables[0] + 3 * qp.variables[1] + 8 * qp.variables[2] + 4 * qp.variables[3] + 6 * qp.variables[4] + 2 * qp.variables[5] + 7 * qp.variables[6] + 5 * qp.variables[7] + 4 * qp.variables[8]
    qp.maximize(linear=objective_expr)

    # Convert to QUBO
    converter = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo = converter.convert(qp)

    # Set up VQE
    optimizer = SPSA(maxiter=100)
    backend = AerSimulator()
    vqe = VQE(backend=backend, optimizer=optimizer)

    # Solve the QUBO

    selected_tasks = [i for i, xi in enumerate(x, start=1) if xi == 1]

    total_cpu_hours = sum(qp.linear_constraints[0].linear[i] for i in range(qp.linear_constraints[0].linear.size) if x[i] == 1)

    # Calculate results
